meta.title: Veda IIT - VLSI Digital Engineering
meta.domain: VLSI Digital Engineering (RTL / DV / Implementation / DFT / Physical Design)
meta.exam: Training and Internship in Applied AI, VLSI & ESD leading to sponsorship and employment by Participating Companies
meta.note: Theory target 23 Sep. 3 days buffer for practice and mock tests before 26-27 Sep exam. Prelim 30M/1hr (9AM) + Mains 70M/2hr (3-5PM).
centers: Hyderabad - VEDA IIT, AYDIV IT Park, Puppalaguda

categories.title: Digital Design
categories.subtitle: Number Systems, Combinational & Sequential - Prelim 15M + Mains 20M

categories.title: Basic Electronics
categories.subtitle: RC Circuits, Diodes, BJTs, Network theorems - Prelim 5M + Mains 10M

categories.title: Aptitude
categories.subtitle: General Mathematical Aptitude + Logical Reasoning - Prelim 10M + Mains 20M

categories.title: Practice & Mocks
categories.subtitle: 3-day buffer 24-26 Sep - prelim + mains mocks + interview

topics.title: Number Systems
subtopics: Different radices/bases and conversions (binary, octal, decimal, hex)
Arithmetic operations on different radices
Signed numbers: signed magnitude numbers
1's complement numbers
2's complement numbers (incl. decimal conversion e.g. 101101110011110.1)
Floating / fractional binary

topics.title: Combinational Logic Circuits
subtopics: Minimization of Boolean functions (Boolean algebra, K-map)
Logic gates (incl. design 4-input NAND using only 2-input NAND)
Multiplexers and Demultiplexers (incl. F(A,B,C) using only 4-to-1 MUX)
Decoders
Encoders, Priority Encoders
Comparators
Adders, Subtractors

topics.title: Sequential Logic Circuits + FSM
subtopics: Latches vs Flip-flops (SR, JK, D, T)
Counters (sync/async, timing waveforms)
Timing waveforms (design sync circuit from waveform using D FFs)
Mealy & Moore State Diagrams
State tables (incl. non-overlapping 1011 Moore FSM)
Clock, setup/hold basics for interview

topics.title: Basic Electronics (RC, Diodes, BJTs)
subtopics: Basic RC Circuits (charging, time constant, frequency response, RMS in series RC)
Kirchhoff's Laws, Node and mesh analysis
Superposition, Thevenin's theorem, Norton's theorem, Maximum power transfer
PN junction diode: clipping, clamping and rectifiers
Zener diode
BJT basics
Impedance design (e.g. 1+4j ohm at w=1) + Vout waveform for R=1K C=1uF square 200Hz

topics.title: C Programming
subtopics: Introduction, Character set, ascii and unicode, Tokens: Keywords, Identifiers, Literals, Operators
Builtin Data Types, Variables, Modifiers, Scope (incl. short int size, operator precedence)
Flow Control Statements, Pointers, Input/Output
Arrays: Single Dimensional for Numbers and characters, Multidimensional arrays
Structures, Bit Fields, Union, Enum, Bitwise ops, Dynamic Allocation of Memory
User defined Functions: Definition, Invocation, Declaration; Libraries
Text Files: Open modes, Opening, Processing, Closing; Binary Files; Low level Programming
Command line Arguments, Function Pointers, Preprocessor Directives
Programs: char-type check (digit/lower/upper/special), output tracing

topics.title: General Aptitude + Logical Reasoning
subtopics: Area, Average, Partnership, Percentage, Ratio and Proportion
Boats and Streams, Pipes and Cistern, Time and Distance, Time and Work, Problems on Trains
Calendar, Clock, Logarithm, Square Root and Cube Root, Volume and Surface Area
Numericals and Numbers, Problems on Ages, Problems on H.C.F and L.C.M, True Discount, Stocks and Shares
Profit and Loss, Races and Games, Height and Distance
Permutation and Combination, Probability
Logical Reasoning (sales/publishing Venn, workers-together, book-price puzzle)

topics.title: Prelim + Mains Mocks & Interview
subtopics: Prelim mock: 20M tech + 10M aptitude, 1 hour, with negative marking drill
Mains mock: 70M (20+10+20+20), 2 hours, fill-blanks + short answers + problems
Previous/sample questions revision (NAND, MUX, FSM, RC, C, aptitude sets)
Technical + Personal interview prep at Hyderabad
topics.examWeight: Buffer 24-26 Sep - do not extend theory beyond 23 Sep
